subject.title: fix(zai): add User-Agent header to endpoint detection probe

question: Should this PR remain blocked for live z.ai Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or may maintainers waive that proof gap based on the source diff and the canonical issue's live header evidence?
rationale: The remaining blocker is proof sufficiency and canonical PR selection, not a code repair that automation can safely perform.

options.title: Require Live Proof Or Waiver
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted live Coding Plan endpoint-detection output, or a maintainer explicitly waives that gap.

options.title: Accept Mock Plus Issue Proof
options.body: Treat the local mock-server transcript plus the canonical issue's live before-fix output as enough and continue normal merge review.

options.title: Choose A Different Candidate
options.body: Land another narrow sibling PR for the same issue and close this PR as superseded after that merge.
